historical_evidence.finding: Tested whether running play type X raises the same team's next 1-5 possession PPP versus a matched baseline. Flat global lifts (SPOT_UP lag-1 +0.027, ctrl_p=0.0000) disappeared after team-season demeaning; within-team memory was essentially none except SPOT_UP lag-1; PNR lag-1 within-team lift -0.0218. Mechanism recorded as C_artifact. Validation not recorded.

Extended possession value. 4 of 8 play types showed a real downstream opponent next-PPP component (CUT +0.0220, TRANSITION +0.0145, SPOT_UP +0.0124, POST_UP +0.0194 suppression). DRIVE downstream not real (opponent ATT +0.0024). Player-level downstream effects mostly non-significant after BH correction. Effects about 0.01-0.02 PPP. Mechanism recorded as E_unclear.

Play-type label accuracy and distribution audit. Recorded verdict tool_eval_fail. OTHER 20.2% against a <10% target; 40.8% low-confidence labels; DRIVE foul-draw rate 1.7% against a 14-22% benchmark; MIA identity checks failed. Mechanism recorded as C_artifact.

Persistent Impact Score Level 1 gate on decaying cross-possession memory. Decay sanity FAILED: DRIVE lifts flat across lags (+0.015 to +0.021); within-team DRIVE lag-1 +0.015 to -0.002; Cohen d about 0.01-0.03 with p near 0 from n>150k per lag (915,570 possessions). Team-quality confound recorded. Verdict failed_gate.

Play-type labeling audit for OTHER and DRIVE foul leakage. 36% of OTHER possessions end in fouls, inflating OTHER PPP; DRIVE 12 percentage points below foul benchmark; PNR 22% foul rate. Only 335 of 50,668 possessions (0.7%) map to a real play type via initiation_type. Verdict artifact_found.

Superstar suppression by lineup and forced play type. Reported lineup-cell PPP gaps (for example Jokic vs MIN -0.385, n=59; Giannis forced PULL_UP -0.540 vs DRIVE) with no placebo or matching; later sequence work treated similar star-chain gaps as artifacts. Mechanism recorded as E_unclear.

Sequential pair premium and defensive aftershock for 8 of 8 play types. After the opponent runs play type X, the next offensive play type Y scores above its unconditional H2 baseline; aftershock after success about +0.119 to +0.135 (for example CUT +0.119, n=21,398; TRANSITION +0.135, n=26,262), replicated in playoffs. Units and definition of the metric are not stated in the retrieved summary. Mechanism recorded as D_positive.

Brown-initiated possession effect on Tatum next-possession points. Propensity-score ATT -0.0165, bootstrap CI [-0.0924, +0.0605]; placebo range covered the real ATT; playoffs ATT +0.0485 with CI [-0.1095, +0.2078]; signs flipped across subsets. Treated n=1173. No failure mechanism recorded.
On-ball defensive scheme labels (DROP/ICE/SWITCH). Confident label rates 14.9% (DET, 10 of 67) and 3.3% (ORL, 2 of 60); switches_on field unpopulated. Mechanism recorded as A_unanswerable.

Opponent PPP after a star's second Q1/Q2 foul over lags 1-3. Raw lag-1 ATT +0.204 was a free-throw artifact (FT share 41.8% treated vs 9.9% control). Excluding free throws, lag-1 +0.0486, CI [-0.0060, +0.0991], perm p=0.0655; no lag cleared CI, permutation and placebo together. Mechanism recorded as C_artifact.

evidence_establishes: Opponent next-possession effects of play types exist in the retrieved analyses as a positive defensive aftershock after success (FAM:SF07, supported), replicated across regular season and playoffs.
Downstream opponent PPP effects reported in FAM:SF-APPS-075 are small (about 0.01-0.02 PPP) and not uniform: 4 of 8 play types showed a real component, DRIVE did not.
Own-sequence (within-team) lagged memory is essentially absent in FAM:SF-APPS-073 and FAM:SF-CHT-029; the global lag signal collapsed after team-season demeaning.
Play-type labels from the play-by-play are not yet valid enough for PPP or foul-based comparison: OTHER share, foul leakage and initiation_type coverage failed in FAM:SF-APPM-014 and FAM:SF-CHT-025.
Several large apparent effects (FAM:SF15 raw +0.204; FAM:SF-APPS-073 global lifts) were recorded as artifacts from composition or construction.
evidence_does_not_establish: No retrieved record defines an AVOID label, its threshold or its derivation. Whether opponent next-possession PPP is large enough to drive AVOID labels is not answered by any record.

The aftershock metric in FAM:SF07 (about +0.12 to +0.13) and the downstream effects in FAM:SF-APPS-075 (about 0.01-0.02) differ by about an order of magnitude; units and definitions are not stated, so they cannot be reconciled from the records.
No record reports a validated, placebo-controlled estimate of opponent next-possession PPP after play X using corrected play-type labels.
Whether 2025-26 regular-season or playoff data (playoffs partial before 2026-06-21) behave like earlier seasons is not addressed; no drift analysis is recorded.
Validation status is NOT_RECORDED in most retrieved records, so no finding is confirmed as independently validated.
own_inferences: The question depends on an AVOID label that is itself outcome-derived; a test of whether PPP drives AVOID labels is partly circular unless the label rule is fixed before outcomes are examined.
If the SF07 aftershock uses a different scale or a conditional rate, it may be consistent with the small effects in SF-APPS-075; this is a hypothesis to check, not a finding.

Given the label failures, apparent large opponent PPP effects in the current pipeline are more likely to reflect foul endings, OTHER-bucket composition or team-quality confounding than an AVOID-relevant effect.

A matched or regression design on team-season-demeaned opponent PPP could plausibly detect about 0.01 PPP (rough own estimate: standard error about 0.004 for two groups of 150,000 possessions, assuming per-possession SD near 1). Detectability is not the same as valid labels.
uncertainties: Units, definition and estimator of the FAM:SF07 aftershock metric are not stated in the returned summary.
FAM:SF-APPM-014 records a verdict of tool_eval_fail and an auto_outcome_status of 'not a hypothesis test'; its record does not give a separate result status.
Several records have validation status NOT_RECORDED or no validation recorded.
The AVOID label definition, threshold and derivation are missing from the task and the retrieved records.
Whether labels were corrected after the audits in FAM:SF-APPM-014 and FAM:SF-CHT-025 is not recorded.
Playoffs 2025-26 are partial before 2026-06-21, so that data version is unstable until then.
Per-play-type exposure counts under the AVOID definition are unknown.

historical_effect.explanation: Before retrieval the question looked testable with the play-by-play data. The retrieved records show that play-type labels fail audit (FAM:SF-APPM-014, FAM:SF-CHT-025), that earlier lagged-memory and foul-related effects were artifacts (FAM:SF-APPS-073, FAM:SF-CHT-029, FAM:SF15), and that the aftershock and downstream evidence is inconsistent in scale (FAM:SF07, FAM:SF-APPS-075). design.estimand: Difference in opponent next-possession PPP after the offense runs play X versus a matched baseline, within team-season, for lags 1-3, conditional on a pre-registered AVOID rule defined before outcomes are examined. Own-sequence lagged effects are estimated separately.
design.unit: Offensive possession (opponent-facing next possession), with the preceding play type X as exposure.
design.sample: Regular seasons 2022-23 to 2025-26 (2025-26 regular season only after completion on 2026-04-13). Playoffs analysed separately; 2025-26 playoffs excluded until complete (2026-06-21). Gate: label audit must pass before any outcome analysis (OTHER share under 10%, foul-ending share reconciled with benchmark, initiation_type coverage defined and reported).
design.power: Pre-specify minimum exposure per play type and team-season. Own rough estimate: about 0.004 SE for two groups of 150,000 possessions, so 0.01 PPP is detectable in pooled regular-season data; playoff and per-team estimates are underpowered and must be reported as such.
design.controls: Team-season demeaning; opponent and offensive team quality; score margin and game state; foul-ending and free-throw exclusion or separate treatment; matched baselines; placebo play types and placebo time shifts; lag-1 to lag-3 with decay check.
design.falsification: Placebo labels (shuffled play-type assignments within team-season) must show no effect; a decay-sanity check requires lag-1 at least as large as lag-2; the FAM:SF-CHT-029 and FAM:SF-APPS-073 patterns (flat lags, collapse under demeaning) count as failure if they recur.
design.multiplicity: Pre-register the play-type and lag set; apply Benjamini-Hochberg across play types and lags; report all tests run.
design.decision_rule: Support requires an effect that clears a pre-specified AVOID threshold with CI excluding zero after team-season demeaning, placebo-controlled, stable across regular season and playoffs, and not explained by foul endings or free-throw composition. Otherwise report artifact, untestable or uncertain as the evidence dictates.
design.data_version: NBA stats API per-game files for 2022-23 to 2025-26 regular seasons (2025-26 complete from 2026-04-13) and playoffs (2025-26 complete from 2026-06-21). Derived possession graph and initiation_type mapping frozen and versioned before analysis; label audit results recorded with the version.

design.decision_rule: Support requires an effect that clears a pre-specified AVOID threshold with CI excluding zero after team-season demeaning, placebo-controlled, stable across regular season and playoffs, and not explained by foul endings or free-throw composition. Otherwise report artifact, untestable or uncertain as the evidence dictates.
